paragraphs.text: The House of Oor-tael was the most powerful of all five Houses in Estark , located in Kush , on Dominaria . Oor-tael's color was turquoise, and its fighters were generally associated with green and blue mana. Fighters of that House were obligated to give part of their time in service to those not of the merchant and noble classes. They were obligated to go on pilgrimage every third year, regardless of rank, to wander as part of their journeyman and master's training, and help the poor with their skills.

Oor-tael was destroyed during the Night of Fire . Every fighter, warrior, mistress, and servant was sentenced to death, with few escaping alive. Some in the countryside may have escaped the destruction, though large bounties were placed on their capture. It was recreated after the Time of Troubles .
Hadin gar Kan (after the Time of Troubles )
